name: PWA provenance badge projection
target: Projects the RFC-hybrid-sim-real §3 provenance source into the PWA's four requested visible badges; the badge helper is a pure projection and the UX simulator calls that production helper without a screen, network, or real-world side effect.
inputs: real, sim, replay, injected, shadow and synthetic-probe provenance event envelopes
observations: sim, replay, injected and shadow map to their requested badges
real and synthetic-probe remain distinct and are not labeled as one of the four badges
missing or unrecognized provenance is displayed as unknown rather than real
event identity and provenance envelope fields remain unchanged
